svg.title: Working Together Does Not Mean Being Identical
svg.desc: Modern teaching cards: Shared aim: Look for a particular aim or action held in common.. Difference: People can cooperate while retaining different experiences.. Evidence: A similar complaint alone does not establish a recorded partnership.
